answer: The quill lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the glacier is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
